checks.detail: requires an explicitly non-synthetic physical_closed_loop run
manufacturer/model/serial/firmware/fixture identity must be complete and hash-bound
host and exact solver artifact identity are required
a present, in-root, digest-matched calibration certificate is required
raw host/target timestamps and physical I/O sequence data must be retained and digest-bound
period, duration, cycle count, zero misses, p99.999 response, jitter and cross-clock error must meet the declared limits
every required fault must be physically injected, traced and observed in a safe state
a separately verified signed manifest is required; an embedded self-assertion is insufficient

limitations: Software tests, simulated loopback, and self-authored timing summaries cannot satisfy this physical gate.
A passing result is qualification evidence for the named host/target/firmware/fixture only, not universal product certification.
